title: Codex code execution — request envelope (MAT-2; MAT-14 timeout_ms; MAT-13 diagnose/review)

schema_version.description: Wire format version. 1.1.0 adds optional `timeout_ms` (MAT-14). 1.2.0 adds `codex.diagnose` and `codex.review` (MAT-13); use 1.2.0 when emitting those ops. Executor must reject unknown versions.

timeout_ms.description: Optional wall-clock budget in milliseconds for this invocation; executor may clamp. Omitted = executor default (MAT-14).

correlation_id.description: End-to-end trace id; echoed on response.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for safe retries. Executor may return replay=true with prior result when safe.

repo_root.description: Absolute or home-relative path to repository root. Accepted formats: / (Unix absolute), ~ or ~user (Unix home-relative), or drive letter (Windows, e.g. C:\). Executors MUST expand ~ paths, validate existence, and reject traversal attempts.

session.description: Optional multi-turn session handle; omit for one-shot runs.

turn.description: Monotonic client-assigned turn counter for this session_id.

instruction.description: Implementation brief; executor translates to model prompt.

scope_globs.description: Optional path/glob allowlist for edits; empty = executor default policy.

acceptance_criteria.description: Optional checklist the worker should satisfy before returning.

readonly_paths.description: Paths or prefixes that must not be modified.

test_profile.description: Executor maps profile to a fixed command template (no free-form shell).

scope_paths.description: Optional directories or files to pass as scoped args to the mapped command.

instruction.description: Symptoms, failing behavior, or hypothesis to investigate; executor maps to a read-oriented RCA prompt.

scope_paths.description: Optional focus paths; omit or empty = executor default search scope.

evidence.description: Observed errors, log lines, stack excerpts, or repro notes.

readonly_paths.description: Paths or prefixes the worker must not modify (diagnose is read-only by policy; paths still constrain tooling).

instruction.description: Review goals (security, API stability, readability, etc.).

minimum_severity.description: Optional floor: worker should only emit findings at or above this severity.
